# Rose & Co

> Small-batch contemporary co-ord sets in hand-painted marble prints. Designed, printed and shipped from Gurugram, Haryana, India. Free shipping across India.

## About

Rose & Co is a D2C womenswear brand launched in 2026. We make one product line — the Amara Marble Swirl Co-ord Set (Rs 1,499) — sold at rose-and-co.vercel.app.

Founder: Aditi Sharma
Studio location: Gurugram, Haryana, India
Fulfilment: Delhi NCR, 24-48 hour dispatch
Payment: UPI only (Full prepaid Rs 1,399 or Partial COD Rs 299 + Rs 1,200)

## Products

- [Amara Marble Swirl Co-ord Set](https://rose-and-co.vercel.app/product/amara-marble-swirl-coord-set): Fitted crop top and high-waist A-line midi skirt in hand-painted marble swirl print on poly-satin blend (90-100 GSM). Deep rose, wine, and warm ivory tones. Sizes XS-XXL. Rs 1,499.
